surface_mechanism_description: The growth of ZnO thin films occurs through a double exchange reaction of diethylzinc (DEZn) with water vapour at the substrate surface in one ALD cycle.
evidence: Zinc oxide thin films were grown as a result of a double exchange reaction of DEZn with water vapour Zn(C2H5)2 + H2O → ZnO + 2C2H6 This reaction occurs at the substrate surface in one ALD cycle.
